## Check the mutations that appear 5 or more times

### Generate prediction results

```{r}
result_matrix = NULL

pcuts = c(5e-3, 1e-2, 5e-2, 1e-1, 2e-1, 5e-1)

for(f1 in res_files_a){
  r1_a = fread(file.path(res_dir, f1))
  r1_b = fread(file.path(res_dir, gsub("alpha", "beta", f1)))
  r1_a$TCR = paste0("alpha_", r1_a$TCR)
  r1_b$TCR = paste0("beta_",  r1_b$TCR)

  r1 = rbind(r1_a, r1_b)
  c_type = str_extract(f1, "(?<=_wo_)\\w+")
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("cancer type", c_type, "\n")
  cat(date(), "\n")

  d1_a = get_dat_one_cancer(c_type, TCR_data_a, mut_data, sample_info)
  mut1_a = d1_a$mut_mat
  tcr1_a = d1_a$TCR_mat
  
  d1_b = get_dat_one_cancer(c_type, TCR_data_b, mut_data, sample_info)
  mut1_b = d1_b$mut_mat
  tcr1_b = d1_b$TCR_mat
  
  stopifnot(identical(mut1_a, mut1_b))
  stopifnot(all(colnames(tcr1_a) == colnames(tcr1_b)))

  rownames(tcr1_a) = paste0("alpha_", rownames(tcr1_a))
  rownames(tcr1_b) = paste0("beta_",  rownames(tcr1_b))
  tcr1 = rbind(tcr1_a, tcr1_b)
  
  mut1 = mut1_a

  n_per_mut = rowSums(mut1)
  ww3 = which(n_per_mut >= 3)
  
  if(length(ww3) == 0){
    cat("no mutation appear in 3 or more subjects.\n")
  }else{
    mut_nms = rownames(mut1)[ww3]
    
    cat(sprintf("there are %d mutation appear in 3 or more subjects.\n", 
                length(ww3)))
    
    mut_nms = mut_nms[which(mut_nms %in% r1$mut)]
    
    cat(sprintf("%d mutations are associated with at least one TCR.\n", 
                length(mut_nms)))
    

    for(j in 1:length(mut_nms)){
      mut_j = mut1[rownames(mut1) == mut_nms[j],]
      res_j = r1[which(r1$mut == mut_nms[j]),,drop = FALSE]
      
      # apply different p-value cutoff for alpha and beta
      for(i in 1:length(pcuts)){
        for(k in 1:length(pcuts)){

          pcut_i = pcuts[i]
          pcut_k = pcuts[k]
          
          ww_A = which(res_j$pval_LRT < pcut_i & grepl("^alpha_", res_j$TCR))
          ww_B = which(res_j$pval_LRT < pcut_k & grepl("^beta_", res_j$TCR))
          ww_i = c(ww_A, ww_B)
          if(length(ww_i) == 0){ next }
          
          tcr_ji = res_j$TCR[ww_i]
          ww_tcr = which(rownames(tcr1) %in% tcr_ji)
          if(length(ww_tcr) == 0){ next }
          
          tcr_pred_ji = colSums(tcr1[ww_tcr,,drop=FALSE] > 0)
          
          auc_val = auc(response=mut_j, predictor=tcr_pred_ji, 
                        quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
  
          auc_ci  = ci.auc(response=mut_j, predictor=tcr_pred_ji, 
                           quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
          
          auc_ci  = signif(auc_ci, 3)
          df1 = data.frame(cancer=c_type, mut=mut_nms[j], auc=signif(auc_val,3), 
                           auc_ci_low=auc_ci[1], auc_ci_med=auc_ci[2], 
                           auc_ci_upper=auc_ci[3], pcut_A = pcut_i, pcut_B = pcut_k)
          
          result_matrix = rbind(result_matrix, df1)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Summerize prediction results

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
setDT(result_matrix)

dim(result_matrix)
result_matrix = result_matrix[order(-auc),]

flextable(result_matrix[1:20,])
table(result_matrix$pcut_A)
table(result_matrix$pcut_B)

pcuts = sort(unique(result_matrix$pcut_A))
length(pcuts)

df_min_auc_4_pcuts <- expand.grid(pcut_A = pcuts, pcut_B = pcuts, 
                                  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE)
df_min_auc_4_pcuts$min_auc = NA
dim(df_min_auc_4_pcuts)
df_min_auc_4_pcuts[1:2,]

auc_cutoffs = seq(0.51, 0.7, by=0.001)

for(k in 1:nrow(df_min_auc_4_pcuts)){
  
  pcut_a = df_min_auc_4_pcuts$pcut_A[k]
  pcut_b = df_min_auc_4_pcuts$pcut_B[k]
  
  auc_vals = result_matrix[pcut_A == pcut_a & pcut_B == pcut_b, 'auc']
  auc_vals = unlist(auc_vals)
  if(length(auc_vals) < 50){
    print(sprintf("pcuts = (%.2e, %.2e), no enough observations.", 
                    pcut_a, pcut_b))
    print("set auc cutoff to be 0.52")
    df_min_auc_4_pcuts$min_auc[k] = 0.52
  }
  
  fdrs = rep(NA, length(auc_cutoffs))
  
  for(i in 1:length(auc_cutoffs)){
    auc1 = auc_cutoffs[i]
    nD = sum(auc_vals > auc1)
    if(nD == 0){ fdrs[i] = 0 }
    else{ fdrs[i] = min(1, sum(auc_vals < 1-auc1)/nD) }
  }
  
  for(i in length(auc_cutoffs):2){
    if(fdrs[i-1] < fdrs[i]){
      fdrs[i-1] = fdrs[i]
    }
  }
  
  df1 = data.frame(auc = auc_cutoffs, fdr = fdrs)
  df_min_auc_4_pcuts$min_auc[k] = min(auc_cutoffs[fdrs < 0.2])
}


ggplot(df_min_auc_4_pcuts, aes(x = -log10(pcut_B), y = min_auc, 
                               color = factor(pcut_A), 
                               group = factor(pcut_A))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = expression(-log[10](pcut[B])),
    y = "AUC",
    color = "pcut_A"
  ) + scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", end = 0.95) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggplot(df_min_auc_4_pcuts, aes(x = -log10(pcut_A), y = min_auc, 
                               color = factor(pcut_B), 
                               group = factor(pcut_B))) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = expression(-log[10](pcut[A])),
    y = "AUC",
    color = "pcut_B"
  ) + scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", end = 0.95) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)


w2kp = NULL
for(k in 1:nrow(df_min_auc_4_pcuts)){
  pcut_a = df_min_auc_4_pcuts$pcut_A[k]
  pcut_b = df_min_auc_4_pcuts$pcut_B[k]
  auck = df_min_auc_4_pcuts$min_auc[k]
  w2kp = c(w2kp, which(abs(result_matrix$pcut_A - pcut_a) < 1e-10 & 
                      abs(result_matrix$pcut_B - pcut_b) < 1e-10 & 
                         result_matrix$auc > auck))
}
length(w2kp)

result_sub = result_matrix[w2kp, 
                  c("cancer", "auc", "auc_ci_low", "pcut_A", "pcut_B", "mut")]

summary(result_sub$auc)
result_sub = result_sub[order(result_sub$auc, decreasing = TRUE),]
dim(result_sub)
flextable(result_sub[1:50,])

```
